documentary_authority.finding: MetaTrader server charts use GMT+3 during US DST and GMT+2 when US DST ends; server time is set by Darwinex

mapping.source_timestamp_basis: Darwinex server civil clock labels preserved in carrier
mapping.reason: US DST: server UTC+3 vs New York UTC-4; non-DST: server UTC+2 vs New York UTC-5

NQX.evidence: V218 NQX exact DEV carrier; recurring daily/weekend session gaps and both sides of 2018-2019 US DST transitions consistent with +7h New York relation

session_conversion.NY_sessions: convert source server civil to America/New_York by -7h, then apply frozen NY session windows
session_conversion.LONDON: derive absolute instant using Darwinex GMT+3/GMT+2 rule keyed to US DST, then convert to Europe/London using IANA DST rules
session_conversion.LONDON_NY_OVERLAP: civil-date intersection after both zone conversions

same_day_exit: last valid executable quote before source-server trading-date change or earlier symbol session break
